description: Use this when someone asks to add a new customer to a business, such as a client they are about to invoice. Returns the customer's id, name, business and language; the email, phone, tax id and address given are saved but never returned. Not for changing an existing customer.

businessId.description: Business id: 24 lowercase hexadecimal characters; may be absent when the account has one business.

email.description: Email address their invoices go to.

language.description: Language for their invoices and messages, as a code such as en, it or pt-BR; the business language when absent.

legalEntity.description: What kind of customer this is; a new customer is stored as a company when absent.

name.description: The customer's full or company name.

phone.description: Mobile number, with the country code when known.

requestId.description: A unique id for this customer, such as a UUID. A repeated call with the same requestId returns the first customer and adds no second one.

taxId.description: Tax or VAT number printed on their invoices.

name: create_customer
title: Add a customer
